feeds.title: Ann Kullberg Blog
feeds.description: Ann Kullberg's blog is full of insights and inspiration from the colored pencil world. CP Workshop cruises, technique and artist stories abound.

feeds.title: KJF DESIGN Fine Art
feeds.description: I am a fine artist primarily working in colored pencil. I teach adult colored pencil classes and workshops at various art associations.

feeds.title: artkleko's Weblog
feeds.description: I am an Australian artist based in Port Macquarie, Australia. I have involved myself deeper in the world of coloured pencils. I am a member of the Launceston Art Society and the Australian Coloured Pencil Artists' Group. I have recently joined the Colored Pencil Society of America and the United Kingdom Coloured Pencil Society.

feeds.title: juliepodstolski
feeds.description: A site to share my coloured pencil drawings, paintings, photographs and thoughts. Julie Podstolski is a full time artist, living in Perth, Western Australia, who works in pencils.

feeds.title: Barbara Goodsitt Studio Blog
feeds.description: Barbara Goodsitt is a contemporary realist artist based in Ann Arbor, Michigan who shares her artwork, classes, and exhibitions on her blog. She works with colored pencils, mixed media, watercolors, and botanical themes, and also teaches drawing at Washtenaw Community College.

feeds.title: Bonny Snowdon Academy Blog
feeds.description: Get useful coloured pencil tips and hints, guides to help you develop your skills, and much more with the help of Bonny Snowdon's weekly blog.

feeds.title: Pencil Topics Blog
feeds.description: The Pencil Topics blog is a compilation of articles and tutorials for colored pencil artists. It features guides on different types of pencils and techniques like layering, blending, and burnishing.

feeds.title: Veronica Winters Painting Blog » Colored Pencil Techniques
feeds.description: The Veronica's Art blog provides articles and tutorials on colored pencil techniques. It covers topics like color harmony, blending, pencil pressure for photorealistic drawings, and preserving artwork with fixatives.

feeds.title: Sandy Allnock » Colored Pencils
feeds.description: Artist, designer, papercrafter, instructor - all wrapped up in one! Visit the website for tutorials three or more times a week.

feeds.title: The Art of Mindy Lighthipe » Colored Pencil
feeds.description: The blog page by Mindy Lighthipe features articles related to art, nature, and conservation, with a focus on colored pencil art. The topics include workshops on drawing and painting, and articles about various animals and travel experiences.

feeds.title: Jeannette Sirois Blog
feeds.description: Explore the colorful world of a skilled colored pencil artist. Discover art techniques, inspiration, and tips for all skill levels.

feeds.title: Draw Awesome Blog
feeds.description: The Draw Awesome blog offers free drawing lessons and tips for artists of all levels. It provides tutorials on subjects like landscapes and portraits using various mediums, including pastel pencils, pen and ink, and charcoal.

feeds.title: Sema Martin Blog
feeds.description: Helpful hints and tips for artists and commissioning artwork. Luxury Realistic Custom Colour Pencil Pet Portraits by Artist Sema Martin, Based in the UK. Worldwide shipping available.

feeds.title: Angrick Art Studio -
feeds.description: A blog about fine art in colored pencil and more. This blog is authored by Carola Angrick Nix. Her passion is working with colored pencils.

feeds.title: Kathryn Hansen graphite and colored pencil drawings
feeds.description: Intricately hand drawn portraits of animals and nature in graphite and colored pencil. I also create custom detailed portraits of pets, animals and wildlife from your own photos!

feeds.title: Colored Pencil Paintings & Mosaics by Judy Carroll Artist Blog
feeds.description: Artist Judy Carroll shows her Colored Pencil Paintings, Mosaics & Original Art Cards in select galleries on this website & blogs about works in progress

feeds.title: Gloria J Callahan
feeds.description: I Blog about creating Fine Art, using Colored Pencils and also Oil Paints. My colored pencil work requires 20-25 layers of artist quality pencils. I hope this blog will show Colored Pencil deserves the respect from collectors and galleries.

feeds.title: Use Your Coloured Pencils
feeds.description: I am an artist and art teacher in Western Australia, currently teaching my sixth year of primary school art. This site is a collection of art lessons I have used for children aged 5-13.

feeds.title: Colored Pencil Enthusiast
feeds.description: Colored Pencil Enthusiast is dedicated to showcasing artists who use colored pencil in some form in their artwork. Curated videos and blogs by colored pencil artists all over the world.

feeds.title: Sharpened Artist Blog
feeds.description: Sharpened Artist is changing the game with a well-rounded, immersive approach to learning the skills you need to chart your artistic course. Art isn't just a hobby for me anymore it is my way of expressing ideas and thoughts. It's my perception and filter of what is around us all.

feeds.title: Colour Pencil Portraits Blog
feeds.description: Colour pencil artist in Bromsgrove, Worcestershire UK- creating original drawings of pets and people using your favourite photos.

feeds.title: Michele Young Art Blog
feeds.description: The Michele Young Art provides information on the artist's work, including portraits of people and pets, as well as pieces featuring classic cars. The content also includes interviews and updates on the artist's projects.

feeds.title: Natalie Wargin Blog » Colored Pencil
feeds.description: Natalie Wargin is a nature and landscape painter based in Cottekill, New York. Her paintings are narratives, each telling a story of the Hudson Valley landscape, focusing especially on the birds and animals that cross her path daily. Her blog is a window into her artful retrospections into the wild and other experiences.
